name: taskwarrior-mcp
description: Local TaskWarrior MCP server for task management, GTD workflows, and recurring task tracking.
long_description:
TaskWarrior MCP exposes a local TaskWarrior installation to Claude Desktop. It supports task creation, modification, GTD review workflows, annotations, dependencies, batch operations, and recurring task reporting.

Prerequisite: TaskWarrior must already be installed on the host machine and the `task` binary must be available on PATH, unless you override it in the bundle settings.

task_bin.title: TaskWarrior Binary
task_bin.description: Optional path or command name for the TaskWarrior executable.

taskrc.title: TASKRC Path
taskrc.description: Optional path to a TaskWarrior configuration file to use instead of the default.
